core_entities.name: Child
core_entities.description: Represents a child enrolled in the daycare.

core_entities.name: Guardian
core_entities.description: A parent or legal guardian responsible for a child.

core_entities.name: Staff
core_entities.description: Employee working at the daycare (e.g., teacher, assistant, administrator).

core_entities.name: Classroom
core_entities.description: A physical or logical group where children are assigned.

core_entities.name: Attendance
core_entities.description: Daily record of a child's presence and hours.

core_entities.name: Payment
core_entities.description: Record of a payment made against an invoice.

core_entities.name: Activity
core_entities.description: Scheduled activity or lesson for children.

key_use_cases: Enroll a new child in the daycare
Record daily attendance (check-in/check-out) for a child
Assign a child to a classroom
Process a payment for an invoice
Log a child's meal, nap, or incident report
View a guardian's contact and billing information
Generate reports on attendance, payments, or classroom occupancy
assumptions: A child can have multiple guardians, but at least one primary guardian is responsible for payments.
Staff members can be assigned to multiple classrooms or roles.
Invoices are generated periodically (e.g., monthly) based on attendance and fixed rates.
Payments are linked to specific invoices and can be partial or full.
Attendance is recorded daily and influences billing.
The system focuses on core operations, not advanced features like meal planning or transportation.
open_questions: Should guardians be able to have multiple children enrolled? (Implied yes, but needs confirmation)
Are there different pricing tiers or plans (e.g., full-time vs. part-time)?
How are late pickups or absences handled in billing?
Is there a need for waitlist management for enrollment?
Should the system support digital signatures for consent forms?
Are there regulatory requirements (e.g., child-to-staff ratios) to enforce?
How are refunds or payment disputes handled?
Should activities be linked to specific learning standards or curricula?
